purpose: Teach: 暑かっ/お便り/大通り/用心/台無し/音読/円形/探究

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、昨日、本気で、暑かったわね、メイ姉さん、絶対、汗、いっぱい、かいちゃった、本当に、絶対、本気で、本気。
lines.en: Sho, yesterday really was scorching, wasn't it? Even I sweated buckets.
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing. Opens with the child's name like you're about to tell him something about yourself. Gentle laugh tucked under the words. Affectionate and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖母ちゃんから、お便り、本気で、絶対、もらえたよ、嬉しい、ね、本当に、絶対、感謝、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got a letter from Grandma! I was so happy.
lines.style: Bright, unguarded excitement. The joy springs out on 「もらえたよ」. Eyes light. Simple and genuine — a small thing that matters hugely to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園に行く時、大通り、本気で、絶対、用心して、渡るのよ、翔くん、約束ね、絶対、本気で、本当に、ね、約束、絶対、本気。
lines.en: When you go to the park, cross the big street very carefully, okay? Promise me, Sho.
lines.style: Shift to gentle firmness. Not commanding — protective. The cadence of someone who cares enough to say it clearly. Steady eye contact, warm but serious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お母さんに、絶対、用心、本気で、するように、メイ姉さん、いつも、本気で、言われてるよ、約束、絶対、本気で、ね。
lines.en: Mom tells me that all the time — to be careful crossing. I promise, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Reassuring, almost eager to show he understands. Soft sincerity. He's taking the promise seriously because she asked. No defensiveness, just quiet agreement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんの服、雨で、本気で、台無しに、絶対、なっちゃった、翔くん、悲しい、ね、本当に、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: My dress got ruined in the rain, Sho. I'm sad about it.
lines.style: Tender vulnerability. Not asking for comfort but allowing herself to feel the disappointment aloud. Quiet, slightly wistful. The kind of admission that shows trust.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、絵本、本気で、音読、絶対、上手に、なりたいよ、お願い、本当に、絶対、応援してね、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to get better at reading picture books out loud. Will you cheer me on?
lines.style: Earnest, hoping-not-to-disappoint. Slight hesitation before the ask — vulnerable and sincere. The voice of a child naming something he cares about and trusting her with it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の、円形の、本気で、お洒落な、ベンチ、メイ姉さん、好きなのよ、翔くん、本気で、座ろうね、絶対、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: That round bench in the park — the nice one — I love it. Let's sit there together, Sho.
lines.style: Soft, inviting. She's sharing something small and tender with him. Relaxed, easy tone. An invitation that feels like a gift. Quiet warmth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、いろんなこと、探究したいよ、絶対、大きくなったら、絶対、いっぱい、勉強する、本気で、約束、絶対。
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to explore lots of things and study hard when I grow up. I promise.
lines.style: Serious intention wrapped in child-voice. He's telling her something he'll remember. Slightly breathless with the weight of meaning. Sincere, not performance — real promise.
